name: PyMuPDF Native Extraction
mechanism: Extracts encoded text, words, blocks, coordinates and tables directly from PDF structure, with optional Tesseract OCR fallback.
use_when: Born-digital PDFs have a reliable text layer
High throughput and coordinate-level provenance matter
avoid_when: Pages are predominantly scans or handwriting
Visual reading order is not represented in the PDF structure
expected_effects: Precise text bounding boxes for citations
failure_modes: Garbled text from broken font encodings
